data.spec: Implemented locally; no hardware/serial/APIroute changes. Samebutton /api/input, speech_transcript and legacytranscript support direct T/RH/CO2/status answers outside purchasing. New environment_queries(task_id PRIMARY KEY,body JSON) stores authoritative read-only answer; legacy GET requests overlay statusresolved,environment:{current:RoomConditionsSnapshot},trace. Snapshot={board_id:string|null,evaluated_at,readings:[{kind:temperature_c|humidity_pct|co2_ppm,value:number|null,last_value:number|null,at:string|null,state:fresh|stale|missing}]}. Room calendar rooms optional board_id must be a known configured board; unmapped named rooms unknown, no unrelated board fallback. Existing room_workflow gains environment:{current,history:{state:insufficient|usually_hot|no_hot_pattern,days,hot_days,hot_fraction,required_days,timezone,window_days,weekday_class,qualified_days,reason},recommendation:avoid|caution|suitable|unknown,summary}; direct namedroom query environment onlycurrent. Room trace adds checking_conditions/checking_history; board.say emits actual short spoken progress. Important meeting advice uses fresh current data and qualified same-localtime past days (3days,15min and>=50%interval coverage,15minbins,weekday/weekend class). No calendar booking or external message from advice. Canonical TS/schema exported as room-environment-snapshot and room-environment-advice; adding optional OfficeRequest.environment and room_workflow type. Ownerroot. Root source hooks staged/tested with88 tests; common modules also in facility-operations worktree.
